title: Clearer answers from the hosted MCP server
items: The hosted MCP server at webhooks.cc/mcp says so when a client still passes targetUrl to render_email or test_webhook_flow: nothing was posted there, and posting to your own URL needs the local server (npx -y @webhooks-cc/mcp)
create_endpoint on the hosted server refuses a Discord public key that is not 64 hex characters before it creates the endpoint
